editorial_thesis: The strongest fresh signal is operational: agents need observable memory, explicit model roles, and system-level safety boundaries.

topic_groups.title: Memory Evaluation
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh November research addresses an under-covered gap: whether agent memory is actually used and helpful, rather than merely retrieved.

sources.title: Delivered, Not Used: Evaluating Agent Memory at Its Point of Use
sources.why_selected: Introduces reference-free point-of-use attribution over 8,000 agent episodes.
sources.usefulness: Provides a concrete trace and evaluation pattern for Buildn agent workflows.

sources.title: MEMOIR: A Training-Free Memory Lifecycle for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
sources.why_selected: Connects evidence-preserving consolidation with retrospective retrieval credit.
sources.usefulness: Offers low-cost, reversible memory lifecycle primitives.

sources.title: Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?
sources.why_selected: Tests linked, evidence-backed topic documents as self-organized memory.
sources.usefulness: Suggests an inspectable alternative to opaque memory stores.

sources.title: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
sources.why_selected: Evaluates candidate memories by replaying their influence on decisions.
sources.usefulness: Useful for designing admission tests before long-term storage.

topic_groups.title: Agent Execution Economics
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh model release makes multi-model routing and worker/verifier role separation concrete, while a new evaluation highlights the limits of monitoring alone.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Agentic Workflows
sources.why_selected: Positions a fast, lower-cost model as an execution tier and reports orchestration gains.
sources.usefulness: Supports a practical planner/worker/verifier routing trial.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: Fast agentic development for coders
sources.why_selected: Shows isolated parallel workspaces and model orchestration in developer workflows.
sources.usefulness: Maps to parallel artifact production and merge gates.

sources.title: How Agent Anomaly Detection scores on benchmarks we didn’t write
sources.why_selected: Reports 87% detection of carried-out harmful instructions and weak poisoned-memory detection.
sources.usefulness: Clarifies where async monitoring helps and where governance must be separate.

topic_groups.title: Physical AI Safety
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Robotics is a deliberate coverage-gap rotation, selected for a transferable systems lesson: safety, runtime, and certification evidence must be designed as one stack.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Halos for Robotics
sources.why_selected: Defines a full-stack safety system spanning compute, sensors, OS, AI, and inspection.
sources.usefulness: Provides a useful vocabulary for agent operational-readiness reviews.

sources.title: Agility Digit: Built for the real world
sources.why_selected: Shows safety integration and industrial deployment context for humanoid robotics.
sources.usefulness: Reinforces that capability is distinct from deployable readiness.

sources.title: National Robotics Week — Latest Physical AI Research
sources.why_selected: Connects simulation, synthetic data, robot learning, and edge deployment.
sources.usefulness: Suggests a staged promotion pattern for agent workflows.
